opening.argument: The evidence presents a rap music release centered on “Boht Tej,” its credited performers, and a stylized performance video. The title identifies “Fotty Seven Feat Badshah | Boht Tej | Latest Rap Song 2020,” while the description says the song is about “the vibes , culture and slangs of Delhi.” The references to listening, downloading, or setting the track as a caller tune through named music services are ordinary distribution instructions. The frame displaying “LISTEN NOW ON WYNK MUSIC” reinforces that music-access context. Nothing described establishes deceptive claims or a financial mechanism.
